title: Sign in
subtitle: Your account email and password
inviteOnly: There is no sign-up: accounts are created by the owner of this Saldo. No account yet? Ask them.
twoStepNote: If two-step sign-in is on, we will ask for a code next.
codeHint: Enter the 6 digits from your authenticator app.

invite.title: {inviter} invites you to the space “{space}” as “{role}”
invite.titleNoInviter: You are invited to the space “{space}” as “{role}”
invite.bodyEditor: You will be able to add operations and mark payments. Your own space stays private.
invite.bodyViewer: You will be able to view operations and payments, but not change them. Your own space stays private.
invite.failed: Could not accept the invitation: no connection. Try again.
invite.acceptedBody: Invitation accepted on {date} at {time}. No need to accept it again.
invite.expiredBody: The invitation was cancelled, or 7 days have passed. Ask the space owner for a new one.
invite.notFoundBody: There is no such invitation. Check that the whole link was copied.
invite.otherEmailBody: This invitation is for {email}, and you are signed in as {current}.

consent.title: Access to Saldo
consent.body: {client} asks for access to your data in Saldo.
consent.note: The client will see what you see, with your role in each space, and will not delete anything. Revoke the access in Settings → Security.
consent.unknownRedirect: The return address {host} does not belong to a known client (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini CLI, MCP Inspector). Saldo gives such a client no access.
consent.failed: Could not save the decision. Start connecting in the client again.
consent.invalidBody: The access request has expired or was already used. Start connecting in the AI client again.
